instruction: Which published patent applications belong in a bibliographic catalogue of the method-related patent interests declared by authors of Genome Biology papers published in 2019 that cite ‘Massively parallel digital transcriptional profiling of single cells’ (2017)? Include an invention only when an author declaration associates a patent interest with a method disclosed in the paper and explicit primary evidence identifies the corresponding published patent application. An unnumbered declaration qualifies when primary evidence explicitly connects the paper and its method to that application; matching authors or titles alone is insufficient. Commercial affiliation alone and a patent merely citing the paper do not qualify. For each qualifying invention, catalogue its published international application and published national or regional phase applications in the same simple patent family. Include application publications dated on or before 9 September 2026. Use one row per application, giving the paper DOI, jurisdiction, application identifier, and the identifier and date of its first application publication under that jurisdiction’s publication numbering system. Exclude unpublished priority filings, grant publications, and later corrections or republications from the choice of first publication. Do not report legal status or rights.
output_format: Return only a pipe-separated table with header paper_doi|jurisdiction|application_identifier|first_application_publication|publication_date. Use bare DOI values, office jurisdiction codes, publication identifiers including kind codes, and YYYY-MM-DD dates. Sort by paper_doi, jurisdiction, then application_identifier.
